intro: Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore is a local bounty posted in Lakeshire by Magistrate Solomon. It calls on adventurers to hunt down Lieutenant Fangore, the vicious chieftain of the Shadowhide gnolls encroaching upon the Redridge Mountains. Eliminating him strikes a direct blow against the renegade sorcerer Morganth, whom the gnolls serve.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth. By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead. Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news do you bring before the Court?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead? Good riddance to that foul creature. You are very brave, adventurer. The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
